review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one definition, `tensorUnitContinuousLinearEquiv`, plus simp lemmas and naturality and uniqueness theorems. The definition reuses Mathlib's `TensorProduct.lid R M` as its `toLinearEquiv`. It adds only the continuity proofs for the one-sided tensor topology, and the module doc says there is no new tensor topology or algebraic unit construction. It is a `ContinuousLinearEquiv` (`≃L[R]`) built on top of the Mathlib equivalence, so it is not a competing version of an existing concept. The remaining declarations are API lemmas about this one construction, and the rubric excludes standalone lemma duplication. I did not search Mathlib for a topological tensor-unit equivalence. I think it unlikely that one exists, because the one-sided tensor topology is specific to this project. I report no finding.
